answer.title: Weekly Timesheet Reminder
answer.trigger: Every Friday at 13:30, check the status of employee timesheets in the payroll system.
steps: Check the payroll system for employees with unsubmitted timesheets.
Draft a reminder email for each employee who has not yet submitted their timesheet.
answer.ai_help: Drafting the friendly reminder emails based on the employee names and missing timesheet status.
answer.risk_reason: The automation only sends reminder emails to staff, so mistakes just result in an unnecessary or mistimed reminder.
